HomeHero.morningDescription: Sungula siku ra wena hi minkarhi ya Bibele leyi khutazaka, leyi endleriweke ku ku khutaza ni ku tlakusa moya wa wena.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Inhlikanhi! Minkarhi ya Bibele ya siku ra wena.

HomeHero.eveningTitle: Riperile! Wisa hi minkarhi ya Bibele.

HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Ntshovelo wu fikile. Hlanganyela na hina loko hi avelana evhangeli na misava hi ku tirhisa midiya ya dijitali.

Mission.eyebrow: Swi akiwile eka vurhumiwa bya misava hinkwayo
Mission.headline: Rungula a ri cinci. Ndlela leyi vanhu va langutaka ha yona ya cinca.
Mission.intro: Hi aka nakambe layiburari ya hina ya tivhidiyo ni switirhisiwa ku sukela emasungulweni, hi yisa ntirho wa makume ya malembe wa ku hundzuluxela eka tipulatifomo laha vanhu va se va hlengeletanaka kona, va languta ni ku avelana.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Layiburari ya tifilimi leyi hundzuluxeriweke ngopfu emisaveni
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Ntirho wa makume ya malembe wa ku hundzuluxela, lowu endliweke hi vatirhisani va vutirheli lava tshembekaka, wu ake layiburari leyi nga na mpfumawulo hi magidi ya tindzimi, leswaku vanhu va kota ku hlangana na mhaka ya Yesu hi ririmi leri va khumbaka swinene.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Ku yisa marito lama tshembekaka eka tifomati letintshwa
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Hi aka nakambe ndlela leyi tindzaba ta evhangeli ti vuriwaka ha yona hi swifaniso, hi hlanganisa swihundzuluxo leswi tshembekaka ni tifomati ta manguva lawa leswaku rungula ri kota ku famba hi ntshunxeko eka tipulatifomo, mindhavuko ni swikirini.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Ku tlula layiburari. Ntlawa lowu fambisiwaka hi vurhumiwa.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project i ntlawa wa misava hinkwayo wa vahundzuluxi, vatirhi va midiya, vahleleri ni vavumbi lava hundzulaka ntokoto wa makume ya malembe wa vutirheli wu va switirhisiwa swa vanhu lava endlaka vadyondzisiwa hinkwako.
Mission.highlightsHeading: Leswi hi swi akaka endzhaku ka sweswi
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Yi hlanganisa vanhu lava langutaka ni tindlela leti vonakaka eka riendzo ra vona ra moya, yi va pfuna ku teka goza leri landzelaka ku ya eka vandlha, Matsalwa kumbe vurhumiwa.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Layiburari leyikulu ya midiya ya Vukreste leyi nga na magidi ya tivhidiyo, tifilimi ni switirhisiwa leswi kumekaka hi tindzimi to tala, swa vutirheli ni ku chumayela evhangeli emisaveni hinkwayo.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Ku lawula tivhidiyo, ku hangalasa swilo, ku hlanganisa vayingiseri ni ku xopaxopa leswi endleriweke ku pfuna vutirheli ku fikelela vanhu vo tala hi ndlela leyinene.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Pfuna ku aka {accent} xa switirhisiwa swa vurhumiwa
Mission.inviteBody: Hi rhamba vatirhi, vavumbi ni vatirhisani ku nghena eka ku fikelela ka ha ri emahlweni. Ringeta switirhisiwa leswintshwa ku sungula, u nyika mavonelo, u pfuna ku vumba swilo leswi endleriweke ntirho wa xiviri wa vurhumiwa.

Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Swi pfula tluka ra vurhumiwa ra Jesus Film eka xiyenge xa mmapa wa ndlela

Feedback.title: Rhumela mavonelo
Feedback.pickKindHeading: U lava ku hi byela yini?
Feedback.successMessage: Ha khensa. Hi kumile mavonelo ya wena.
Feedback.failureMessage: A swi kotekanga ku swi rhumela. Ringeta nakambe endzhaku ka timinete ti nga ri tingani.
Feedback.messagePlaceholder: Hi byele leswi u swi voneke.
Feedback.translationMessagePlaceholder: I marito wahi lama hoxekeke, naswona ma le ka xikirini xihi? Engetela ku hundzuluxela loku antswaka loko u ku tiva.
